ios.desc:
Capture your work while it is fresh.

Tenths helps attorneys, consultants, and other professionals track billable time in tenths of an hour. Start a timer, add time manually, or use on-device AI on a supported device. Keep the work organized by client, matter, and entry, then export it when you are ready to bill.

TIMEKEEPING THAT FITS YOUR DAY
- Track time in 0.1-hour, six-minute increments.
- Start and pause a timer, add time to an existing entry, or save it for assignment later.
- Record work for the correct date, including time you need to enter afterward.
- Browse clients, matters, entries, and date-filtered totals in Manager.

PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE AI
Turn spoken notes into time entries and refine entry descriptions with Apple Foundation Models. AI is included with Free on supported devices with Apple Intelligence enabled and available. Dictation also requires on-device speech recognition for your language. Tenths does not send AI requests, transcripts, or workspace context to an AI server. Manual time entry remains available when on-device AI is unavailable.

YOUR CLIENT WORK, ENCRYPTED
Sensitive workspace information is encrypted on your device. Sync through your own iCloud account across compatible Apple devices. You can also work without iCloud; export your work regularly before replacing a device or removing the app.

REPORTS READY FOR THE NEXT STEP
Create PDF, CSV, and Excel exports. Choose clients, matters, and dates, review billing information, and share the finished report with your back office or billing workflow.

START WITH FREE
Free includes unlimited time tracking, iCloud sync, on-device AI on supported devices, and one export each calendar month.

CHOOSE PLUS FOR UNLIMITED EXPORTS
Tenths Plus adds unlimited PDF, CSV, and Excel exports through an optional monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription. Current prices and any eligible trial appear in the app before purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Existing Tenths AI subscribers retain Plus access while their subscription is active.

Built for professionals who want to spend less time reconstructing their day and more time doing their work.

Privacy Policy: https://tenths.io/docs/PrivacyPolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

quotes.text:
This problem space is so interesting. You have the 'always on' approaches like yours, or you have things like Toggl and Clockify etc. There will always be tension in "always on at my desk" vs. "on the go" time tracking.

I'm always on the road, so very few of these 'track my screen for billing' tools appeal to me. Tenths, though, has been a good fit for my lifestyle. It's honestly helped me with my ADHD, too.

Good luck on your endeavors!

Tenths is only on iOS, the website doesn't have much other info: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tenths-billing-time-keeper/id1608993411
